description: This source file defines the code-behind for a web page that manages a theory exam interface. It handles loading questions from a database, displaying them, timing the exam, and submitting answers by inserting data into related database tables.

classes.name: TheoryExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the TheoryExam ASP.NET Web Forms page, managing page load, question retrieval, answer submission, and timing.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; retrieves questions from the database based on session data, initializes exam timer, and displays questions.

methods.name: getCourseName
methods.description: Returns the full course name based on the course ID.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Collects student's answers, inserts responses into the database, updates course queues, and marks the exam as taken.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and navigates to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates remaining exam time display and enforces time expiration.
